description:
We are Ctrl-alt-space, a team of two. One of us is a medical doctor and the other is a software engineer.

Dr. May Cohn, Medical Doctor and Biomedical Researcher. May designs the clinical side of ORBIVIT: the assessment workflows, the warning-sign screening, the order of the diagnostic tests and the approved intervention pathways.

Liel Bach, Software Engineer. Liel builds the system: the engine that detects deviations, the AI reasoning, the offline AI model, the backend and the user interface.
